title: SPLASH: SPlit thickness donor site Lipoaspirate AssiSted Healing
summary:
The randomized, controlled, double-blind study investigates the effect of autologous fat transfer on the re-epithelialization of split-thickness skin graft donor sites.
Split-thickness skin is harvested from both thighs. On one side, autologous lipofilling (liposuction from the abdomen) is performed, while the other side serves as a reference.

interventions.name: In patients with an indication for reconstruction using split-thickness skin grafts, a wound inevitably forms at the donor site of the graft.
